Name: Secure secrets + environment configuration
Description: Store API keys (Places/Yelp, LLM provider) securely, configure per-environment variables, and ensure they are not exposed to client.

Name: Set up Next.js app scaffold + core routes
Description: Initialize Next.js project, add basic routing for onboarding, chat, and settings. Establish shared layout, navigation, and environment config.

Name: Create UI component library for MVP screens
Description: Build reusable components (buttons, inputs, cards, chat bubbles, loading states, empty states) to keep UI consistent and fast to iterate.

Name: Integrate Supabase Auth (server + client)
Description: Configure Supabase project keys, implement auth middleware/session retrieval, and protect authenticated routes.

Name: Database: create profiles table + RLS policies
Description: Define profiles schema and row-level security so users can only read/write their own profile.

Name: Implement authentication UI (sign up / login)
Description: Create screens for signup/login/logout and basic session handling in the client.

Name: Database: create user_preferences table + RLS policies
Description: Define preferences schema (cuisines, restrictions, travel radius) and secure with per-user RLS.

Name: API route: Update user preferences
Description: Implement endpoint to update cuisines, dietary restrictions, and travel radius for the authenticated user.

Name: Create “Profile & Preferences” onboarding flow (UI)
Description: Build onboarding steps for cuisine preferences, dietary restrictions, and travel radius input.

Name: Preferences settings page (post-onboarding)
Description: Allow users to update cuisines, dietary restrictions, and travel radius after onboarding.

Name: Database: create budget_slots table + RLS policies
Description: Schema for weekly slots (days_of_week, start_time, end_time, min_budget, max_budget) with RLS.

Name: API route: CRUD budget slots
Description: Implement endpoints to create, update, delete, and list budget_slots for the authenticated user with validation.

Name: API route: Get current user profile + preferences
Description: Implement authenticated endpoint to fetch profile and preferences from Supabase for client hydration.

Name: Create “Budget Slots” onboarding flow (UI)
Description: UI to add/edit/delete weekly budget slots with day(s) of week, start/end time, and min/max budget.

Name: Budget slot time picker + day-of-week selector components
Description: Implement UX controls for selecting time ranges and days with validation (start before end, required fields).

Name: Budget slots management page (post-onboarding)
Description: CRUD UI for budget slots after onboarding, reusing onboarding components.

Name: Implement slotResolver service (MVP rules)
Description: Given current day/time and the user’s budget slots, determine the active slot. Handle edge cases (no slot, overlapping slots).

Name: API route: Resolve active budget slot for now
Description: Endpoint that returns the active budget slot (or fallback) to support “Find Food” and chat requests.

Name: Location permission request + capture current coordinates
Description: Implement browser geolocation permission handling, user-friendly fallbacks, and persist last known location for session use.

Name: Build chat interface MVP
Description: Implement chat thread UI with message list, input box, submit handling, and displaying 3–5 recommendations as cards.

Name: Implement restaurantProvider (Google Places or Yelp)
Description: Integrate external restaurant API to fetch nearby open restaurants given lat/lng + radius, including pricing/rating when available.

Name: Implement restaurant filtering (budget, open now, radius, dietary constraints)
Description: Filter candidate restaurants by travel radius, open status, and budget range; apply dietary restrictions in a best-effort way based on available metadata.

Name: Implement recommendationScorer (deterministic scoring)
Description: Score restaurants using budget fit, cuisine match, distance, rating, and lightweight preference boosts based on prior selections.

Name: Implement chatOrchestrator workflow (LangGraph skeleton)
Description: Wire a LangGraph flow that accepts a user query, calls slotResolver + restaurantProvider + scorer, and produces a structured response.

Name: LLM prompt + response schema for chat explanations
Description: Create prompts that explain “why these picks” using the computed results (without letting the model re-rank). Enforce structured JSON output.

Name: API route: Chat recommendation request
Description: Endpoint that takes user message + location, runs the orchestrator, and returns structured recommendations (3–5 + optional wildcard).

Name: Frontend rendering of recommendations + “why” explanations
Description: Display restaurant cards with key info (name, distance, price, rating) and an explanation blurb generated from the orchestrator.

Name: Add “Find Food” quick action entry point
Description: Add a prominent button that launches a recommendation request using current context (time + location).

Name: Error handling + user-friendly fallbacks for recommendation flow
Description: Handle “no location,” “no restaurants found,” “API down,” and “no active budget slot” cases with clear UX and safe backend defaults.

Name: Track recommendation events on generation
Description: When recommendations are returned, write a recommendation_events record including context (slot, budgets, location cell, filters).

Name: Database: create recommendation_events table
Description: Store each recommendation response payload (restaurant ids, scores, slot used, request context) for analytics/personalization later.

Name: Database: create user_actions table
Description: Log clicks and selections of recommended restaurants (and wildcard usage) to support behavior tracking.

Name: API route: Log user action events
Description: Authenticated endpoint for recording click/select actions with related recommendation_event id.

Name: Track user actions (click/select/wildcard)
Description: Instrument UI events and create endpoint(s) to record actions into user_actions.

Name: Performance budget + latency instrumentation
Description: Add timing metrics around provider calls, scoring, and total request time; log slow requests and ensure under-3s target is measurable.

Name: Database: create restaurant_cache table + RLS/service access
Description: Cache restaurant results keyed by geohash/cell + query params + timestamp; define access rules (likely service role only).

Name: Caching layer for restaurant queries
Description: Implement read-through cache using restaurant_cache to reduce external API calls and improve latency; define TTL strategy.

Name: Basic personalization hints (MVP lightweight)
Description: Add simple boosts based on historical user_actions (for example, cuisines selected more often, price tolerance inferred). Keep logic deterministic.

Name: Implement wildcardEngine (MVP heuristic)
Description: Select a high-quality candidate slightly outside usual cuisine preferences while staying within reasonable distance and acceptable budget bounds.

Name: Add “Wildcard” UI affordance
Description: Add a “Wildcard” button/toggle in chat results that requests a wildcard recommendation and renders it distinctly.
